AMISTAD ZONING AUTHORITY
VAL VERDE COUNTY COURTHOUSE
P. C. BOX GG - PHONE 775-9329
DEL RIO, TEXAS 78840
May 11, 1976
Mr. J. L. Johnson, P. E. Acting Chief Engineering Division Fort Worth District Corps of Engineers P. O. Box 17300 Fort Worth, Texas 76102
Dear Mr. Johnson:
Judge Sergio Gonzales, Jr., has asked that this office respond to your April 22nd letter concerning the environmental impact of installing hydroelectric generators at Amistad Dam.
The land below the Dam to the Amistad Zoned Area is zoned agriculture. There are no proposed projects at this time. We do not anticipate any use for the area other than agriculture, recreation and gravel. The increased flows from Amistad Dam will not affect these uses.
The land area from the boundary of the Amistad Zoned Area has several houses. However, future development shall be limited due to the Flood Insurance Program in Val Verde County. The increase flow should not affect this use either.
We feel that the installation of hydroelectric generators will not adversely affect the area from the Dam to the Val Verde County line.
However, the environmental impact on the Lake itself is a different matter. Consideration should be given to shore line erosion, vegetation, fish spawn and the use of the Lake itself.
If you need additional information, please contact this office as well as the Judge's office as this will expedite matters.
Sincerely,
Dan Siebeneicher, Director of the
Amistad Zoning Authority
